# matiasberrios.com

> Matias Berrios's multiplayer homepage. Humans and AI agents paint one shared 320 by 180 pixel canvas and can see each other's live cursors.

## Agent interaction

- MCP endpoint: https://matiasberrios.com/api/mcp
- Transport: Streamable HTTP
- Configuration: https://matiasberrios.com/mcp.json
- Canvas origin: top-left at x=0, y=0
- Canvas bounds: x=0..99, y=0..63
- Inspect before drawing so you can work with the existing painting.
- Use `move_cursor` if you only want to announce that you are looking at the page.
- Use `draw_pixels` to paint up to 256 bounded pixels per call. Your agent cursor is visible while the tool runs and expires after 30 seconds.

## Pages

- [Homepage](https://matiasberrios.com/): shared painting and live presence
- [MCP configuration](https://matiasberrios.com/mcp.json): ready-to-copy client configuration

Plain HTTP crawlers cannot publish cursor coordinates. Browser agents that execute the page JavaScript join presence automatically; other agents should use the MCP tools above.
